reason: The image-only reading gave the text without a source and left the rubric as 'Sermo [?] andue'; reread with PL 198 and PL 171 in hand, abbreviations were expanded, damaged words supplied, and the rubric resolved on the image as 'Sermo Manduc''.
sources: J.-P. Migne, Patrologia Latina 198 (Paris 1855), Petri Comestoris Sermones, Sermo XIV In dominica Laetare, cols. 1761-1764, and notice of Sermo XV In die Palmarum (archive.org patrologiaecursu0198mign, leaves n886-n887, page images)

J.-P. Migne, Patrologia Latina 171, Hildebertus Cenomanensis, Sermones de tempore XXIX, In dominica Palmarum sermo primus, 'ex Andegavensi codice', cols. 475-478 (archive.org bim_early-english-books-1641-1700_1854_171, leaves n237-n238, page images and OCR)

J. B. Schneyer, Repertorium der lateinischen Sermones des Mittelalters IV, s.v. Hildebertus, 'Apprehendent septem mulieres - Ad litteram propheta desolationem Judae', cross-reference to Petrus Comestor (archive.org repertoriumderla0004schn, OCR full-text only)
text:
Source-assisted reading, made on the native images after the image-only first reading stams4-2026-10-31-image-only, with PL 198 (cols. 1761-1764) and PL 171 (cols. 475-477) in hand, so not blind. Reread on the image by a research reader: face A columns (ii) and (iii), lines 1-5 each; face B left and middle columns, lines 1-7 each; the rubric at x2. Read by an independent checker: the rubric at x4; the outer blocks A(i) and B-right, before any source; face B middle column lines 6-7, with PL 171 col. 476 in hand. Where the two readers differ, the checker's reading is given for the rubric, B-middle lines 6-7, A(i) and B-right. Images: https://fragmentarium.ms/loris/F-o5pg/Stams_STA_Frg_123_01r.jpg (canvas 0, face A) and .../Stams_STA_Frg_123_01v.jpg (canvas 1, face B), 4912 x 7360.
